detail: ok: got '7/10', expected '7/10' | ok: got 5726994.0, expected 5726994.0 | ok: got '2027-01-19', expected '2027-01-19' | ok: got 37.0, expected 37.0
answer:
A: Total draws \(C(10,3)=120\); all different \(=3\cdot4\cdot3=36\), so probability \(=1-36/120=7/10\).

B: Multiples of 7 sum to \(6{,}867{,}546\); multiples of 42 sum to \(1{,}140{,}552\); difference \(=5{,}726{,}994\).

C: \(2026-09-19\) is Saturday. Counting weekdays and skipping the listed holidays gives \(2027-01-19\).

D: Product \(=302{,}269{,}404{,}052{,}000\); digit sum \(=37\).

FINAL: 7/10; 5726994; 2027-01-19; 37
